plan.question: Do Fresh complete suites match, and which public phases account for the mariamem/pgmem Fork suite difference?
plan.order: rotate four product/mode cells each round; reverse parallel order on odd rounds
plan.warmup: one separate fresh process per cell (12)
plan.pilots: one 2-case positive and one wrong-seed negative per product/mode, P1
plan.workload: 1000 integer rows, SELECT1, COUNT/SUM, UPDATE id1, verify row; Fresh seeds per case; Fork seeds and captures once
plan.timed: internal suite from preparation start through final cleanup; external process wall measured separately; excludes build/download
plan.observations: per-case startup, connect, seed, SQL, retirement, Close; critical worker lane, CPU and lifetime max RSS; no runtime overlay
plan.exit: Complete finite matrix, state when costs appear and whether Fresh is close; causal internals may remain unknown. No optimization or prewarming implementation.
